figures.name: Lac Long Quan

ability.name: Dragon of the Sea
ability.description: All dragon and water allies gain +3 to all stats; deal 5 damage to sea enemies.

figures.description: The Dragon Lord who civilized Vietnam and married the Fairy Au Co to birth the 100 ancestors of the Vietnamese.

figures.name: Au Co

ability.name: Hundred Children
ability.description: Summon one powerful ally from a cosmic egg; grant all allies +2 to all stats.

figures.description: The fairy woman who laid 100 eggs birthing the Vietnamese people and took 50 children to the mountains.

figures.name: Thanh Giong

ability.name: Iron Horse Charge
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to all enemies in a line; destroy all enemy fortifications.

figures.description: The miraculous boy who ate mountains of rice, grew instantly to giant size and drove off the invaders on an iron horse.

figures.name: Bach Ho

ability.name: White Tiger Strike
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy; all metal and war allies gain +2 power.

figures.description: The White Tiger deity of the western direction who governs metal, war and autumn.

figures.name: Tran Hung Dao

ability.name: Spirit General
ability.description: All Vietnamese warrior allies gain +3 power; ward off all Mongol-type invasion abilities.

figures.description: The great general who defeated the Mongol invasion three times and became a divine protective spirit.

figures.name: Kim Quy (Golden Turtle)

ability.name: Golden Claw
ability.description: Provide a divine weapon: grant one ally +4 power; then reclaim it at battle's end.

figures.description: The divine golden turtle who gave magic weapons to protect the Viet and reclaimed them when peace was restored.

figures.name: Tao Quan

ability.name: Year End Report
ability.description: Reveal all hidden information to your side; grant +1 to all ally stats from the kitchen gods' favor.

figures.description: The three Kitchen Gods who watch all household deeds and report to the Jade Emperor on New Year's Eve.

figures.name: Ngoc Hoang

ability.name: Celestial Decree
ability.description: One ally's next ability cannot be countered or resisted by any enemy.

figures.description: The Vietnamese version of the Jade Emperor who governs all celestial affairs from his heavenly palace.

figures.name: Nam Hai

ability.name: Southern Sea
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all water allies; deal 2 damage to northern or invading enemies.

figures.description: The southern sea dragon deity who protects Vietnamese fishing communities and governs the South China Sea.

figures.name: Ba Chua Xu

ability.name: Realm Protection
ability.description: All allied cards from the south are protected from northern abilities for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Lady of the Realm goddess of the Mekong Delta whose shrine receives millions of pilgrims annually.

figures.name: Phung Hung

ability.name: Boxer's Power
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to any oppressor-type enemy that has higher stats than this card.

figures.description: The folk hero who led a revolt against Tang China and became a protective spirit king after death.

figures.name: Than Tai

ability.name: Wealth Blessing
ability.description: Grant one ally +3 to all stats from the wealth god's morning blessing.

figures.description: The Vietnamese god of wealth propitiated early each morning to ensure commercial prosperity.

figures.name: Rong (Vietnamese Dragon)

ability.name: Dragon Rain
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; call rain to restore all earth and nature effects.

figures.description: The benevolent Vietnamese dragon who brings rain and prosperity, entirely different from European dragons.

figures.name: Than Song Ha

ability.name: River Blessing
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all water allies; prevent all flood damage to allies for 1 turn.

figures.description: The deity of rivers and streams whose blessing keeps the Red River Delta fertile and prevents catastrophic floods.

figures.name: Ba Vi Mountain Spirit

ability.name: Triple Peak
ability.description: Grant +1 to three different stats for three different allies simultaneously.

figures.description: The spirit of the three-peaked sacred Ba Vi mountain who guards the northern Vietnamese heartland.

figures.name: Chim Lac

ability.name: Lac Flight
ability.description: This card can move to any position; deal 3 damage from aerial speed.

figures.description: The ancient Lac bird depicted on Dong Son bronze drums — the national symbol of Vietnam's deepest ancestry.

figures.name: Phap Luan

ability.name: Dharma Turn
ability.description: Remove all immoral effects from allies; grant +2 wisdom to all Buddhist allies.

figures.description: The archetypal Vietnamese Buddhist monk who spreads the dharma wheel through prayers and community service.

figures.name: Quan Am

ability.name: Southern Mercy
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to one ally who is critically wounded; remove all suffering effects.

figures.description: The Vietnamese form of Guanyin — Quan Am — the goddess of infinite mercy worshipped at every roadside shrine.

figures.name: Hai Ba Trung

ability.name: Sisters' Revolt
ability.description: Two allies gain +4 power simultaneously from the power of united resistance.

figures.description: The legendary Trung Sisters who led the first Vietnamese revolt against Chinese rule on war elephants.

figures.name: Coc Than

ability.name: Rain Toad
ability.description: Restore 1 HP to all allies; inflict wet status on all fire enemies from the rain toad's calling.

figures.description: The magical three-legged toad who calls rain by daring to fight heaven and forcing the Jade Emperor to relent.
